# `aitbc explorer search-transactions`

Search transactions for an address with a result limit.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer search-transactions [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--address` | text | — | yes | Blockchain address to fund. |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Number of transactions to return |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer search-transactions --address <address>
```
